rule: Class names must use PascalCase (e.g. TestSuite).
Method names must use camelCase and be descriptive.
Constants must be static final and SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
Use @BeforeMethod for setup instead of repeating code in tests.
Test methods must always be annotated with @Test.
Use specific Assert methods (assertEquals) over generic assertTrue.
Always include a descriptive failure message in assertions.
Tests must be independent and not rely on execution order.
One test method should focus on one specific scenario (Atomic tests).
Use @DataProvider for parameterized testing of multiple inputs.
Tests must be located in src/test/java (not src/main/java).
Tests should fail via Assertions rather than throwing raw Exceptions.
example: try { ... } catch (IOException e) { Assert.fail(\File not found\"); }"

rule: Avoid Thread.sleep(); use explicit or fluent waits.
Test classes should have a Javadoc summary of the test suite.
Use 4 spaces for indentation (standard Java convention).
